data.name: Amit
data.gender_notes: Amit is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit a, 'not', + mita, 'measured' — 'boundless, immeasurable'. Its root is Sanskrit a + mita. A classical Sanskrit term for the infinite. Amit is a Sanskrit name meaning “Boundless; infinite; immeasurable”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Amit expresses “Boundless; infinite; immeasurable”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit a, 'not', + mita, 'measured' — 'boundless, immeasurable'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amit total 16, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.

vedic_reference.note: The name Amit is derived from the Sanskrit word अमीत (amīt), which means boundless or immeasurable. It is also the name of the god of infinite space, Amitabha, in Buddhist and Jain traditions.
